facts.fact: The Ministry of Economy and Finance said the E-Quitus tax clearance platform was developed by the ministry's own IT teams, coordinated by the CAISFF, with the administration's own means.
The Minister of Economy and Finance officially launched E-Quitus on 23 January 2024, a platform built by ministry staff that issues tax clearance within three working days at most.

systems.owner: Ministere de l'Economie et des Finances (CAISFF)
